entry.title: New: Bill 134 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 25, ARTICLE 2, SECTION 25-2-42 OF THE HAWAIʻI (Draft 2) COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO AMENDMENTS INITIATED BY PROPERTY OWNERS AND OTHER PERSONS

Requires the Planning Director to submit a subject area report to the applicable planning commission and County Council along with each change of zoning district application. The report would specify all changes of zone granted to surrounding properties, any incomplete and time sensitive conditions applied at the time of the change of zone, and the maximum number of lots into which each surrounding property could be subdivided. Surrounding properties would include properties within 1,000 feet of the property for which the change of zone is sought for applications in the State Land Use Agricult
